q: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.
Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
In Defense of the King's Lands
Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
Bring pages 1, 4, 6, and 8 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter I.
Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.
Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
Bring Krazek's Fixed Pot to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.
Deliver Trol'kalar to Zengu in Hammerfall.
Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.
Bring 8 Timberling Seeds to Denelan at Lake Al'Ameth.
Get 7 pieces of Scrap Metal for Sigrun.
Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.
Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
Take the Proof of Deed back to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.
Grab a Flawed Power Stone. Bring it to the Altar of Fire before the stone expires, then return to Ak'Zeloth.
Retrieve 7 Highborne Relics for Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.
Find Gelkak's First Mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, and lead it back to Gelkak.
Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector Ironband.
Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.
Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
Retrieve Haggard's Badge from Dead-tooth Jack's camp, and return to Marshal Haggard.
Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine wants 8 Corrupt Brain stems.
Bring a Mirror Lake sample to Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.
Destroy 4 Ju-Ju Heaps, then return to Un'thuwa in Sen'jin Village.
Return the Horns of Nez'ra to Arantir's Shadow in Lakeshire.

Bring the Southsea Treasure back to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet. Do not forget to get an E.C.A.C. and Thieves' Tools from Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus. You will need both of these items to complete your mission.
Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village wants you to destroy 5 Eggs of Onyxia.
Retrieve Khadgar's Essays on Dimensional Convergence and deliver them to Watcher Mahar Ba in Nethergarde Keep.
Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.
Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.
Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water.
Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.
Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Find Sentinel Shaya and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar.
Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.
Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.
STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.
Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.
Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
Control 5 bases in Arathi Basin at the same time, then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
Do a flex emote at Innkeeper Allison, and in exchange you'll receive Stormwind Nougat!

Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 20 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Cenarius to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of War, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Vermillion Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Return to Fenstad Argyle outside the bank in the Undercity.
Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in Stormwind's Trade District.
Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Elements, Kilt of Elements and Pauldrons of Elements.
Using the Tome of the Cabal, summon and subdue a felhunter, then return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Tunic if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Sandals if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sandals, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 8 Bolts of Runecloth, 6 Essences of Water, 4 Ironweb Spider Silks and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 2 Frozen Runes, 2 Essence of Water, 2 Blue Sapphires and 30 gold pieces.
Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms
Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
